Congratulations to Saturday’s Generation Duel winners! From left to right, we have Skyler Hennessey (5th, GX), Desmond Boyd (2nd, 5D’s), Ashlin Noble (1st, ARC-V), Dejan Borjanoeic (3rd, ARC-V), Paul Scheffelin (6th, GX), and Lu Zheng (4th, ARC-V).
Being the Ultimate Duelist is a prize all its own. To know you’ve surpassed all challengers to become the Champion. That said, it’s much more than just a title!
The winner of the UDS Invitational will take home the UDS Championship Belt!
That Championship Belt isn’t just a fashion accessory. Bring it with you to a Regional, and you’ll get free entry! Bring it to a YCS tournament, and it’s free entry
VIP seating and a two round BYE!

Of course, you can’t always go around wearing a title belt. Well, you can, but you probably shouldn’t. For those times, you can wear the special UDS Invitational Winner’s pin, or the UDS Top Cut pin. The Ultimate Duelist also takes home an Ultra Rare copy of the
YCS Prize Card! It’ll play nicely on the exclusive UDS Top Cut Game Mat.
The UDS Invitational winner will also receive travel and accommodations to return for the next UDS Invitational. It’s only fair – they have to defend their title!
Free tournament entry, a prize card, a crazy awesome belt, and more. Being the Ultimate Duelist sure is sweet!
